# Review findings:

## Finding 1 (cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go:323-339) [added]
[P2] Existing v2 checkpoints can skip compact transcript backfill

This path now treats an existing v2 checkpoint as fully migrated whenever all `/full/*` raw artifacts are present. It no longer checks `existing.Sessions[i].Transcript`, so older/partial v2 checkpoints that have raw `/full` data but no `/main/transcript.jsonl` are skipped forever unless the user reruns with `--force`.
